installation_retry_note: The first production install saw the new root version before index propagation. The next attempt required explicit prerelease selection for transitive alpha pins. Final production installation uses --prerelease allow, with no cache or local artifact links.
registry_propagation_note: After successful first upload, the version-specific JSON API returned 404 while the project JSON record already exposed alpha4. Verification uses the project record only when its version exactly equals 0.1.0a4; hashes and Documentation URL must match.
